records.summary: Vet Bea, 33, wants to be a mother and, after adoption falls through, gets pregnant using her gay friend Mauri as donor (ch. 30). While pregnant she starts dating Rosa, and she gives birth in ch. 42 while with Rosa, who fights Mauri over the 'father' role. Later Bea's partner Ana decides to carry; a mix-up means she inseminates with Mariano's sperm instead of Fernando's, gets pregnant and miscarries (ch. 83).
records.character: Couples: Bea (Eva Isanta) and Rosa (María Almudéver); later Bea and Ana (Vanesa Romero)

sources.label: Investigaciones Feministas (UCM), 2019 – Maternidades lésbicas en la ficción televisiva española
TV Tropes – All Lesbians Want Kids

records.pregnancy_note: Bea gives birth in chapter 42; Ana's pregnancy ends in miscarriage in chapter 83.
records.kids_note: No children when Bea conceives. When Ana conceives, Bea already has her baby, so Ana carries as a bonus mom: the second pregnancy in Bea's relationships.

episodes.gist: Bea becomes pregnant using Mauri as a known donor.
Rosa and Mauri argue over who gets the 'father' role.
Bea gives birth while dating Rosa.
Bea and Ana ask Fernando to donate sperm.
After a mix-up Ana is pregnant by Mariano's sperm and miscarries.

records.fit_note: Bea was single when she conceived and met Rosa while pregnant.
records.provenance: Lesbian-couple pregnancy research pass, 30 Sep 2026 (adult couples only; non-explicit notes)
records.pregnant_has_children: no for Bea; yes for Ana (co-mother of Bea's baby)
records.pregnancy_again_note: after Bea's birth, partner Ana's pregnancy ends in miscarriage (ch. 83)
